name: Red-winged Blackbird
facts: Call pattern: a gurgling "conk-la-ree!" delivered while the male flares his red shoulder patches.
Habitat: cattail marshes, wet ditches and field edges. Males defend territories fiercely, even against hawks and people.
Migration: short-distance. Males return in late winter, making them one of the first signs of spring in the Midwest.
